nodes.name: Confirm sent
nodes.notes: Only reached if the mail actually went. A failure upstream returns 500 to the caller, which is what makes "report not sent" honest.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ formname: "Leads", operation: "getRecordsBySearch", searchcondition: "Mobile Number@contains@" + String($json.body.phone).replace(/\D/g, "").slice(-10) + "@AND$", displayfields: ["Contact Name", "Mobile Number", "Email Address", "Lead Date", "Lead Source"], pageno: 1, numofrecords: 5 }) }}

nodes.name: Search Cratio by mobile
nodes.notes: Credential: Query Auth, name "apikey", value = your Cratio API key. Cratio takes the key as a query parameter, so it stays in n8n and out of this file. searchcondition uses the FIELD LABEL exactly as the CRM shows it — "Mobile Number", not "Mobile". `contains` on the last ten digits, because Cratio stores +919643330741 and the form sends the bare number. Searched by mobile rather than email: the @ in an email address collides with searchcondition's own separator.
